cards.name: Sparkstep Runner
cards.rulesText: Blink. A cheap storm courier for sudden lane pressure.
cards.description: Lightning learns the shortest road.

cards.name: Cloudline Raider
cards.rulesText: Blink. A mobile midgame threat that attacks from changing angles.
cards.description: It strikes where the forecast said clear skies.

cards.name: Aetherbolt Avatar
cards.rulesText: Blink. A high-cost finisher with unrestricted repositioning.
cards.description: The storm itself takes a war-form.

cards.name: Stormgate Sentinel
cards.rulesText: Vanguard. Protects Zeus ranged lanes from return fire.
cards.description: A grounded rod for enemy violence.

cards.name: Thunderhead Guardian
cards.rulesText: Vanguard. A durable mid-cost screen for storm formations.
cards.description: Behind it, the sky prepares judgment.

cards.name: Reef Tunneler
cards.rulesText: Mole. Deploy beneath a controlled Land and emerge when it falls.
cards.description: It swims through stone as easily as surf.

cards.name: Trench Stalker
cards.rulesText: Mole. A resilient ambusher hidden beneath tidal Lands.
cards.description: Pressure and patience make its armor.

cards.name: Abyssal Leviathan
cards.rulesText: Mole. A buried late-game threat that punishes destroyed Lands.
cards.description: The seabed rises because it has awakened.

cards.name: Breakwater Hoplite
cards.rulesText: Vanguard. Holds firing lanes while Poseidon builds its board.
cards.description: Every wave breaks somewhere.

cards.name: Maelstrom Bulwark
cards.rulesText: Vanguard. A heavy guardian for layered tidal positions.
cards.description: The current circles an immovable heart.

cards.name: Grave Skulker
cards.rulesText: Mole. Conceals early pressure beneath Underworld Lands.
cards.description: The dead keep roads beneath every road.

cards.name: Styx Burrower
cards.rulesText: Mole. Converts a collapsing Land into an ambush.
cards.description: It follows the river below the grid.

cards.name: Tartarus Colossus
cards.rulesText: Mole. A hidden high-cost executioner for attrition decks.
cards.description: A prison door given fists.

cards.name: Shade Ferryman
cards.rulesText: Blink. Repositions through the veil to control targets.
cards.description: No wall divides this bank from the next.

cards.name: Erebus Reaper
cards.rulesText: Blink. Hunts weakened enemies from any open square.
cards.description: Darkness is a doorway with a blade behind it.

cards.name: Bloodshield Recruit
cards.rulesText: Vanguard. An aggressive screen that advances with the rush.
cards.description: The shield is another weapon.

cards.name: Phalanx Breaker
cards.rulesText: Vanguard. Protects the assault while hitting above curve.
cards.description: It breaks formations by becoming one.

cards.name: Titan of the Red Line
cards.rulesText: Vanguard. A late-game spearhead and mobile line-of-sight wall.
cards.description: War draws its boundary in red.

cards.name: Flashblade Skirmisher
cards.rulesText: Blink. Appears in an open lane to keep aggression constant.
cards.description: Distance is a hesitation it refuses.

cards.name: Warpath Telearch
cards.rulesText: Blink. A mid-cost flanker that threatens every empty square.
cards.description: Its charge begins at the destination.

cards.name: Aegis Cadet
cards.rulesText: Vanguard. Establishes an efficient defensive firing screen.
cards.description: The first lesson is where to stand.

cards.name: Owlguard Strategos
cards.rulesText: Vanguard. Anchors a deliberate midgame formation.
cards.description: It wins the lane before the arrow flies.

cards.name: Pallas War Savant
cards.rulesText: Vanguard. A premier defensive finisher that controls sight lines.
cards.description: Every attack arrives already answered.

cards.name: Hidden Flank Scholar
cards.rulesText: Mole. Banks a defender beneath a strategically placed Land.
cards.description: Some reserves wait below the map.

cards.name: Labyrinth Tactician
cards.rulesText: Mole. Creates a concealed second defensive layer.
cards.description: The best position is the one unseen.

cards.name: Bronze-Line Automaton
cards.rulesText: Vanguard. A cheap machine screen for Forge engines.
cards.description: It was built to be the first thing struck.

cards.name: Foundry Bastion
cards.rulesText: Vanguard. Shields Structures while the engine develops.
cards.description: A walking wall fresh from the mold.

cards.name: Colossus Prime
cards.rulesText: Vanguard. A high-cost machine that locks down firing lanes.
cards.description: The forge completes its argument.

cards.name: Subforge Sapper
cards.rulesText: Mole. Waits under a Land as a concealed repair-line defender.
cards.description: Every foundation hides another workshop.

cards.name: Mantle Borer
cards.rulesText: Mole. Stores a powerful counterattack beneath Forge Lands.
cards.description: Its drill follows the planet's oldest seam.
